queues: Default production partition; 1-91 nodes: max 2 hours, 92-183: max 6 hours, 184-9472: max 12 hours; up to 4 eligible jobs per user. Optional debug QoS: max 2 hours, one job per user, debugging only.
Long-running jobs: max 64 nodes and 24 hours; one running and one eligible job per user.
Isolated development nodes; requires develop QoS as well as the service partition; max 4 nodes and 2 hours, one running and one eligible job per user.

olcf_dtn_filesystem.description: OLCF filesystem paths accessible through the Frontier IRI resource and OLCF DTN (Globus 5)

metadata.notes: Frontier compute identity comes from OLCF discovery. Filesystem operations use configured Globus fallbacks; chmod is unsupported. The manual native route retains the assumption that filesystem calls use frontier with root /. The Globus route is supplied manually and partition descriptions come from the Frontier user guide. Across all partitions, each user may have at most 100 jobs in all states.
